services.desc: Our completely renovated beach cabins are boutique inspired, comfortable and fully equipped for your relaxing stay. Each cabin has new furniture, flooring, appliances and decor. All cabins have 2 bedrooms, the parent room with a Queen Bed and the other with Twin Bunks. All Cabins are equipped with a BBQ on the deck and patio set. The grounds include a large children’s playground and access walk on Beachfront to popular Saratoga Beach. If you’re looking for a sandy beach location, shallow warm waters, and friendly people, you’ve found the right place. All cabin pricing is based on 4 person occupancy.
